g.text: A: local academic deployment (Docker Compose, committed) B: future managed deployment (growth path, NOT part of the MVP)
A Local academic deployment — one machine with an NVIDIA GPU, Docker Compose
Compose network: public (only the proxy is published)
B Future managed deployment (illustrative, not committed)
A is the committed MVP. B only shows that the same components and the same database queue scale by adding
instances (more API replicas, more GPU workers) without a message broker or a new data model.
Differences in B: object storage replaces the media volume (MediaStore implementation changes only),
managed PostgreSQL replaces the container, signed short-lived URLs are issued after the ownership check.
Not part of any deployment here: billing, subscription, organisations, admin panel, Kubernetes.
Trust boundaries: browser -> proxy is the only public path; db, media and worker have no published ports.
Start-up order (A): provision roles and login accounts (superuser, once) -> migrate (DDL owner, no CREATEROLE) -> api, worker, maintenance.
